# ComboBox

Header: `winui/ui/input/ComboBox.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/input/ComboBox.hpp`.

A combo box: a closed box showing one item of a list of strings, and a chevron that opens the list as a popup floating above the rest of the tree, so opening it never reflows the layout.

By default the box is read-only and the value is always one of the items (or nothing, showing the placeholder). A click, Space, F4 or Alt+Down opens the list. While open, hovering or Up/Down moves the highlight, and a click or Enter picks it and closes the list; Escape or a click outside closes it unchanged. While closed, Up/Down change the selection directly. Typing jumps to the next item starting with the typed letters; letters typed within a second of each other add to the search.

set_editable(true) turns the box into a text field the user can type any value into. Typing at the end of the text completes it to the first item it starts, with the completed part selected so the next letter replaces it. Enter or losing focus commits the text: text equal to an item picks it, other non-blank changed text raises [on_text_submitted()](#on_text_submitted). Escape reverts to the last committed text. Only F4 or Alt+Down open the list (Space is an ordinary character), and the list always shows every item ([AutoSuggestBox](auto-suggest-box.md#uiautosuggestbox) filters as you type). The control stays one tab stop; typing and caret movement go to an internal [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox), which draws its own caret and selection.

Example: 
```cpp
// Declarative: ui::ComboBox builds a ui::ComboBoxControl.
ui::Property<std::optional<std::size_t>> size{1};
window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::ComboBox{
            .header         = "Size",
            .items          = {"Small", "Medium", "Large"},
            .selected_index = size,
        },
        ui::Text{.text = ui::bind(size, [](std::optional<std::size_t> i) { return std::format("Index {}", i.value_or(0)); })},
    },
});

// Imperative and editable: any text goes, the items are suggestions.
auto combo = std::make_unique<ui::ComboBoxControl>(std::vector<std::string>{"Red", "Green", "Blue"});
combo->set_editable(true);
combo->set_header("Colors");
combo->set_placeholder_text("Pick a color");
combo->on_item_chosen([](std::size_t index) { /* index into items() */ });
combo->on_text_submitted([](const ui::ComboBoxTextSubmittedArgs& args) {
    return args.text.size() > 20 ? ui::Cancel : ui::Proceed; // too long: not committed
});
window.set_content(std::move(combo));
```

## `ui::ComboBox`

A combo box: pick one of a list, or with [`editable`](#uicombobox-editable) type any value. Builds a [ui::ComboBoxControl](#uicomboboxcontrol).

[`items`](#uicombobox-items) is applied before [`text`](#uicombobox-text) and [`selected_index`](#uicombobox-selected_index), so a bound index always lands inside the list. When both are bound, [`text`](#uicombobox-text) follows the selection.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<std::optional<std::size_t>> size{1};
ui::Property<std::string>                color{"Blue"};

window.set_content(ui::VerticalStack{
    .spacing = 8,
    .content = {
        ui::ComboBox{
            .header         = "Size",
            .items          = {"Small", "Medium", "Large"},
            .selected_index = size,
            .width          = 200.0f,
        },
        ui::ComboBox{
            .header            = "Colors",
            .placeholder_text  = "Pick a color",
            .items             = {"Red", "Green", "Blue"},
            .text              = color,
            .editable          = true,
            .width             = 200.0f,
            .on_text_submitted = [](const ui::ComboBoxTextSubmittedArgs&) { return ui::Proceed; }, // free text
        },
    },
});
```

```cpp
ui::ComboBox{
    .header, .description, .error, .placeholder_text, .items, .selected_index, .text,
    .editable, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width,
    .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled,
    .accessibility, .on_text_changed, .on_item_chosen, .on_selection_changed,
    .on_text_submitted, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus,
    .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control
}
```

### ComboBoxControl

```cpp
ComboBoxControl()
```

An empty, read-only combo box (not focusable until it has items).

### ComboBoxControl

```cpp
ComboBoxControl(std::vector<std::string> items, std::optional<std::size_t> selected_index = std::nullopt)
```

A read-only combo box offering [`items`](#items). [`selected_index`](#selected_index) is clamped to the list; unset (the default) starts with nothing selected, showing the placeholder. Sets a 64 DIP minimum width.

### editable

```cpp
bool editable() const
```

Whether the user can type a value of their own. False (the default) only picks items.

### set_editable

```cpp
void set_editable(bool editable)
```

Switches between the read-only box and the text field. The text carries over: turning editing off keeps the selection, and drops typed text that matches no item. Updates the layout.

### items

```cpp
const std::vector<std::string>& items() const
```

The list's choices (UTF-8), in display order.

### set_items

```cpp
void set_items(std::vector<std::string> items)
```

Replaces the item list and closes the popup. A read-only box clears its selection, firing [on_selection_changed()](#on_selection_changed) when something was selected; an editable one keeps its text, and the selection follows it to the new list.

### selected_index

```cpp
std::optional<std::size_t> selected_index() const
```

Index into [items()](#items) of the selected item: the item the text matches exactly, when editable. Unset when nothing is selected.

### set_selected_index

```cpp
void set_selected_index(std::optional<std::size_t> index)
```

Shows item `index`, as picking it would, without raising [on_item_chosen()](#on_item_chosen). Read-only, the index is clamped to the list; editable, an index past the list is ignored. Unset clears the selection (and, editable, the text when it shows an item).

### text

```cpp
const std::string& text() const
```

The text in the box (UTF-8): the selected item's, or empty with nothing selected; when editable, whatever was typed or picked.

### set_text

```cpp
void set_text(std::string text)
```

Read-only, selects the item equal to [`text`](#text), or nothing when none is. Editable, replaces the text and moves the caret to the end without firing [on_text_changed()](#on_text_changed), which is for user edits only. The new text is also the committed text Escape reverts to.

### placeholder_text

```cpp
const std::string& placeholder_text() const
```

The hint shown while nothing is selected or the text is empty; empty by default.

### set_placeholder_text

```cpp
void set_placeholder_text(std::string text)
```

Sets the hint ("Pick a color"). Updates the layout, since a read-only box fits its width to it.

### header

```cpp
const std::string& header() const
```

The label above the control. Empty by default.

### set_header

```cpp
void set_header(std::string header)
```

Sets the header. Empty draws none and takes no room. A change updates the layout.

### description

```cpp
const std::string& description() const
```

The secondary text under the box; empty (the default) draws none.

### set_description

```cpp
void set_description(std::string description)
```

Sets the description. Empty draws none and takes no room. A change updates the layout.

### error

```cpp
const std::string& error() const
```

What is wrong with the value, shown in the description's place in the critical color, with the border in the same color; empty (the default) shows the description.

### set_error

```cpp
void set_error(std::string error)
```

Sets the error. A change updates the layout and redraws.

### automation_help_text_fallback

```cpp
std::string automation_help_text_fallback() const override
```

The description, or the error while one is set, is the help text a screen reader offers when [accessibility()](../tree/element.md#accessibility).description is empty.

### automation_invalid

```cpp
bool automation_invalid() const override
```

Invalid while an error is set.

### automation_name_fallback

```cpp
std::string automation_name_fallback() const override
```

The header names the control when [accessibility()](../tree/element.md#accessibility).name does not.

### on_selection_changed

```cpp
void on_selection_changed(Callback<void(std::optional<std::size_t>)> handler)
```

Fires when the selection changes: an item picked, Up/Down or typing while closed, text typed or set that matches another item or none, [set_items()](#set_items) or [set_selected_index()](#set_selected_index). Unset when it was cleared; not for a write that lands on the current item.

### on_item_chosen

```cpp
void on_item_chosen(Callback<void(std::size_t)> handler)
```

Fires when the user picks an item from the open list (a click, or Enter on the highlighted item), even if the box already showed it, and when an editable box commits typed text equal to an item. Receives the index into [items()](#items); the box already shows the item when it fires.

### on_text_changed

```cpp
void on_text_changed(Callback<void(const std::string&)> handler)
```

Editable only: fires with the new text after any user-driven text edit (typing, Backspace, Delete, UI Automation's SetValue), once completion has filled it in. Not fired after [set_text()](#set_text) or when an item is picked (that is [on_item_chosen()](#on_item_chosen)). Replaces any previous handler.

### on_text_submitted

```cpp
void on_text_submitted(Callback<Decision(const ComboBoxTextSubmittedArgs&)> handler)
```

Editable only: fires when typed text matching no item is committed (see the class comment). Return [ui::Cancel](../core/namespace-ui.md#cancel) to reject the text, typically after putting the last good value back with [set_text()](#set_text); the text is then not committed.

### expanded

```cpp
bool expanded() const
```

Whether the item list is open. Opened by the user or through UI Automation's ExpandCollapse; never opens while [items()](#items) is empty, and there is no public setter.

### focused

```cpp
bool focused() const
```

Whether the control (and so, editable, its inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox)) holds keyboard focus.

### focusable

```cpp
bool focusable() const override
```

True while enabled and holding at least one item; an editable box needs no items, since it is still a free-text field.

### for_each_child

```cpp
void for_each_child(ChildVisitor visit) const override
```

Lists the internal [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox) while editable, so it is updated, animated and drawn along with the combo box.

### collect_focusables

```cpp
void collect_focusables(std::vector<Element*>& out) override
```

One tab stop: the internal [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox) is part of this control, not a stop of its own.

### automation_children

```cpp
void automation_children(std::vector<Element*>& out) const override
```

The internal [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox) is part of this node and not listed. While the list is open, a List node of the items, each a ListItem a client can select.

### automation_focus

```cpp
Element* automation_focus() const override
```

The highlighted item while the list is open, so a screen reader reads it as the arrow keys move.

### handle_context_menu

```cpp
bool handle_context_menu(std::optional<Point> position, ContextMenuHost& host) override
```

Editable: the inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox)'s context menu, Cut/Copy/Paste/Select All only, with no spelling section. Read-only: none.

### cursor_at

```cpp
std::optional<CursorShape> cursor_at(Point p) const override
```

Editable: the text field's cursor over the text field (an I-beam, an arrow over its buttons).

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

A [ComboBox](#uicombobox), with its text as the Value pattern (read-only unless editable) and ExpandCollapse for open and close.

### caret_bounds

```cpp
std::optional<Rect> caret_bounds() const override
```

Editable: the inner text box's caret.

### visual_state

```cpp
ButtonState visual_state() const
```

The Normal/Hover/Pressed/Disabled state the control draws in: the whole closed box when read-only, the chevron button when editable.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Desired width fits the widest item, and the placeholder (read-only) or the inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox)'s own desired width (editable), so the box doesn't reflow as the selection changes. Desired height is the header plus one row, open or closed, since the list floats as a popup.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Places the header, and when editable the inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox) beside the chevron column.

### pointer_override

```cpp
bool pointer_override(const PointerEvent& e) override
```

A click on the box (read-only) or on the chevron (editable) toggles the list; anything else in an editable box goes to the [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox). Clicks on the open list reach the popup.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the header, the box with its text (or placeholder) and the chevron. The open list is a popup the window draws.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Ticks the inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox), runs the list's slide-open, where the theme has one (Theme::popup_motion.list), and times out the typed search.

### enabled_changed

```cpp
void enabled_changed() override
```

[is_enabled()](../tree/element.md#is_enabled) flipped, through [set_enabled()](../tree/element.md#set_enabled) here or on an ancestor, or a move to another parent. Drop any press or hover state. The element is redrawn either way. No-op by default.

### focus_changed

```cpp
void focus_changed(bool focused) override
```

Called by [Window](../tree/window.md); mirrored into the inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox). Losing focus closes the list, and an editable box commits its typed text.

### key_override

```cpp
bool key_override(const KeyEvent& e) override
```

F4 or Alt+Down/Up toggles the list; Up/Down/Enter/Escape drive it while open. Read-only, Space toggles it and Up/Down step the selection while closed. Editable, Enter commits and Escape reverts while closed, and everything else edits the text.

### text_override

```cpp
bool text_override(const TextInputEvent& text_event) override
```

Typed text searches the items (read-only) or goes to the inner [TextBox](text-box.md#uitextbox) (editable).

### focus_ring_rect

```cpp
Rect focus_ring_rect(const Theme& theme) const override
```

Read-only: around the box; inside the classic field, round the selected text, while the list is closed.

### focus_ring_corner_radius

```cpp
float focus_ring_corner_radius(const Theme& theme) const override
```

The ring's corner radius: the theme's control radius by default.

### draws_focus_ring

```cpp
bool draws_focus_ring() const override
```

Read-only only: an editable box shows focus with its accent border.
